title: Hardwired Distributed Processing Units for Inference: Neural Decisions at the Sensor that Free the Host
abstract: arXiv:2611.06436v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: We show that a hardwired distributed processing unit (HDPU) can take a neural decision at the sensor and so remove the inference from the host. Built for zebra-crossing detection on a low-cost Artix-7 FPGA, the unit decides on every camera frame in a fixed 2,269,477 clock cycles (34.04 ms depends upon Fpga clk ), inside the 37.49-ms frame period, and on the board it returns the same scores and decisions as its bit-exact software model on all 639 test images. The whole detection path, from camera pixels to decision, takes 1,814 LUTs, with no processor, no operating system and no full-resolution frame store. When the unit answers instead of reporting "not sure", 95.7% of its answers on street photographs are correct, and a hardware contrast stage lifts accuracy on camera-like dashcam frames from 47.7% to 78.2%. translated_title: 用于推理的硬连线分布式处理单元：在传感器端做出神经决策，解放主机
translated_abstract: 我们证明了一种硬连线分布式处理单元（HDPU）可以在传感器端完成神经决策，从而将推理任务从主机中移除。该单元专为低成本Artix-7 FPGA上的斑马线检测而构建，在固定的2,269,477个时钟周期（34.04毫秒，取决于FPGA时钟频率）内对每一帧相机图像做出决策，处于37.49毫秒的帧周期之内；在全部639张测试图像上，它在板卡上返回的分数和决策与其位精确的软件模型完全一致。从相机像素到决策的整个检测路径仅占用1,814个LUT，无需处理器、无需操作系统，也无需全分辨率帧存储器。当该单元直接给出答案而不是报告“不确定”时，其在街景照片上的回答正确率达到95.7%；此外，一个硬件对比度处理级将类相机行车记录仪帧上的准确率从47.7%提升到78.2%。主机因此被完全免除了推理负担：每个帧周期可节省一个核心8.13毫秒的计算时间，而全精度ResNet-18则需要更多资源。
tldr: 该论文提出一种在低成本Artix-7 FPGA上实现的硬连线分布式处理单元（HDPU），仅用1,814个LUT、无需处理器和操作系统即可在传感器端以固定时延完成神经推理决策（如斑马线检测），从而将全部推理负担从主机中解放出来。
en_tdlr: This paper presents a hardwired distributed processing unit (HDPU) implemented on a low-cost Artix-7 FPGA that performs neural inference decisions at the sensor with fixed latency (e.g., zebra-crossing detection) using only 1,814 LUTs without any processor or OS, thereby freeing the host from all inference workloads.
